Name: Persistent Qi Beans and Qi Fruit and Calico Eggs
Author: Dragoon23
Description:
[size=4][b]Persistent Qi Beans, Qi Fruit, and Calico Eggs[/b][/size][size=3][b]
[/b]
Qi Beans, Qi Fruit, and Calico Eggs will not be deleted from inventory or shops after the Qi Shipping quest/Desert Festival ends. Qi Giant fruit will always give Qi fruit.

Options: Everything is Customizable in the config file.
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Qi Beans - Seeds only. [/size]
[*][size=3]Qi Fruit - Fruit and Crop. Crop can be grown regardless if quest is on or not.[/size]
[*][size=3]Qi Giant Fruit Warning Override -  Chopping down Giant Qi Fruit will always give Qi Fruit regardless if quest is on or not.[/size]
[*][size=3]Calico Eggs[/size]
[/list]
[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=3][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/size]
[*][size=3]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].[/size]
[*][size=3]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size]
[/list]

[size=5]How to use[/size]
[size=3]Config file is generated after first launch. Everything is on by default.[/size]


[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6 on Windows.[/size]
[*][size=3]Works in single player.[/size]
[*][size=3][size=3]Should be compatible with Linux/Mac/Multiplayer but I only test for Windows/single player so can't say for sure.[/size][/size]
[/list]
